The PM guard now allows the actions reported on 2026-10-09 and still refuses the ones that should stay closed. Both verification commands pass, along with the wider guard suites and the typecheck. Nothing is committed.

**Changed paths** (all within `owns_paths`):
- `lane-stack/hooks/guard_shell.py`
- `src/rooms/native-install/native-hook-sources.ts` (regenerated with `scripts/gen-native-hook-sources.mjs`; the script was run, not edited)
- `tests/guard.test.ts`, `tests/guard-bb-threads.test.ts`, `tests/native-session-hooks.test.ts`
- `CHANGELOG.md` (one bullet under `## Unreleased`, no version bump)

**Causes, reproduced before fixing:**
- **`.mts` refusals:** `/tmp` and `.bb/chats/` writes were limited to text suffixes (`.md .json .yaml .yml .txt`).
- **REPORT.md refusal:** the heredoc check looked for `\beval\b` anywhere on the command line, so the `skill-eval` directory made a `> quoted` line in the report body parse as a shell redirect. It now counts a shell only as a command word.
- **`cd … && … > labels.json`:** relative redirect targets resolved against the payload cwd, not the `cd` target.
- I ruled out NFC/NFD of «BB-сервис»: paths in either form resolved the same.

**Changes:**
- The Lane Pilot PM may run `bb thread stop|archive|unarchive|cancel-plan` and `bb settings show|usage|version`. `bb thread new` and settings setters stay denied.
- Any file type under `/tmp`, `/private/tmp` and `$TMPDIR` is allowed. In `.bb/chats/<chat>/`, any file type is allowed except `thread.json` and `history/`.
- Relative redirect and `sed -i`/`tee` targets resolve from the folder a leading `cd` sets.
- Heredoc bodies fed to something other than a shell are not parsed; bb-command checks skip them too.

**Decisions to review:**
- Thread control and settings reads apply to the Lane Pilot PM (`lane-pilot-pm` and the BB-native PM with `LANE_PILOT_AGENT_TYPE`). The CLI `dev-orchestrator` allowlist is unchanged, and a test pins that.
- The guard has no chat id, so any `.bb/chats/<chat>/` counts as the PM's own, as before. Narrowing to the PM's own chat would need the chat id passed into the hook.
- A literal `$TMPDIR/…` in the Write tool is still refused, because the tool does not expand it and the file would land in the project. Real absolute paths under `$TMPDIR` are allowed.
- Temp-folder precedence still applies to absolute paths, so a checkout that itself lies under `/tmp` loses protection for absolute paths. Relative shell targets keep project rules there. BB worktrees live under `~/.lane-pilot`, so this only matters for an unusual layout.
- Unquoted heredoc bodies are still stripped without checking for `$(…)` expansion. That is a pre-existing gap and I did not change it.

**Tests:** I changed the old expectations that archive was denied (in `native-session-hooks.test.ts` and `guard-bb-threads.test.ts`). New allowed and refused cases cover each item in the acceptance list.

**Verification:**
- `npx vitest run tests/native-session-hooks.test.ts tests/guard-secret-cli.test.ts`: 24 passed.
- Wider guard suites (14 files): 346 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing).
- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0.
